implementation:
let rec go (n a p r : Nat) : Bool :=
  if a = 0 then true else
  match n with
  | 0 => false
  | k + 1 => if a + (a * r + 5000) / 10000 ≤ p then true else go k (a + (a * r + 5000) / 10000 - p) p r
let rec search (n a r lo hi : Nat) : Nat :=
  if lo < hi then
    if go n a ((lo + hi) / 2) r = true then search n a r lo ((lo + hi) / 2) else search n a r ((lo + hi) / 2 + 1) hi
  else hi
termination_by hi - lo
decreasing_by all_goals omega
Int.ofNat (search v2.toNat v0.toNat v1.toNat 0 (2 * v0.toNat))
proof:
by
  intro v0 v1 v2 h
  simp only [pre, pre0, post, post0] at *
  obtain ⟨h0, ⟨h1, h2⟩, h3, h4⟩ := h
  have A : ∀ (r p : Int), 0 ≤ r → 0 ≤ p → ∀ (l : List Int) (s : Int), s ≤ 0 → List.foldl (fun (s0 : Int) (q0 : Int) => ((s0 + (Int.fdiv ((s0 * r) + (0x1388 : Int)) (0x2710 : Int))) - p)) s l ≤ 0 := by
    intro r p hr hp l
    induction l with
    | nil => intro s hs; simpa using hs
    | cons x t ih =>
      intro s hs
      simp only [List.foldl]
      apply ih
      have hm := Int.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hs hr
      rw [Int.fdiv_eq_ediv_of_nonneg _ (by decide)]
      simp only [Int.zero_mul] at hm
      omega
  have B : ∀ (b q : Nat) (l : List Int) (a : Nat), (implementation.go l.length a q b = true ↔ List.foldl (fun (s0 : Int) (q0 : Int) => ((s0 + (Int.fdiv ((s0 * (b:Int)) + (0x1388 : Int)) (0x2710 : Int))) - (q:Int))) (a:Int) l ≤ 0) := by
    intro b q l
    induction l with
    | nil =>
      intro a
      unfold implementation.go
      by_cases ha : a = 0 <;> simp [ha] <;> omega
    | cons x t ih =>
      intro a
      have hstep : (a:Int) + Int.fdiv ((a:Int) * (b:Int) + 5000) 10000 - (q:Int) = ((a + (a*b+5000)/10000 : Nat) : Int) - (q:Int) := by
        rw [Int.fdiv_eq_ediv_of_nonneg _ (by decide)]
        have hc := Int.natCast_mul a b
        omega
      unfold implementation.go
      simp only [List.length_cons, List.foldl]
      by_cases ha : a = 0
      · rw [if_pos ha]
        constructor
        · intro _
          apply A _ _ (by omega) (by omega)
          rw [hstep]
          subst ha
          omega
        · intro _; rfl
      · rw [if_neg ha]
        try dsimp only
        by_cases hp : a + (a*b+5000)/10000 ≤ q
        · rw [if_pos hp]
          constructor
          · intro _
            apply A _ _ (by omega) (by omega)
            rw [hstep]
            omega
          · intro _; rfl
        · rw [if_neg hp, ih, hstep]
          have e : ((a + (a*b+5000)/10000 : Nat):Int) - q = ((a + (a*b+5000)/10000 - q : Nat) : Int) := by omega
          rw [e]
  have C : ∀ (n a b d lo hi : Nat), hi - lo = d → lo ≤ hi → implementation.go n a hi b = true → (lo = 0 ∨ implementation.go n a (lo-1) b = false) → (implementation.go n a (implementation.search n a b lo hi) b = true ∧ (implementation.search n a b lo hi = 0 ∨ implementation.go n a (implementation.search n a b lo hi - 1) b = false)) := by
    intro n a b d
    induction d using Nat.strongRecOn with
    | _ d ih =>
      intro lo hi hd hle hhi hlo
      rw [implementation.search]
      by_cases hlt : lo < hi
      · rw [if_pos hlt]
        by_cases hm : implementation.go n a ((lo+hi)/2) b = true
        · rw [if_pos hm]
          exact ih (((lo+hi)/2) - lo) (by omega) lo _ rfl (by omega) hm hlo
        · rw [if_neg hm]
          exact ih (hi - ((lo+hi)/2+1)) (by omega) _ hi rfl (by omega) hhi (Or.inr (by simpa using hm))
      · rw [if_neg hlt]
        have hq : lo = hi := by omega
        subst hq
        exact ⟨hhi, hlo⟩
  have key : ∀ x : Nat, (implementation.go v2.toNat v0.toNat x v1.toNat = true ↔ balance_after v0 v1 (x:Int) v2 ≤ 0) := by
    intro x
    have e := B v1.toNat x (List.map Int.ofNat (List.range v2.toNat)) v0.toNat
    simp only [List.length_map, List.length_range] at e
    rw [e]
    unfold balance_after loop0
    have e0 : ((v0.toNat : Nat) : Int) = v0 := Int.toNat_of_nonneg h0
    have e1 : ((v1.toNat : Nat) : Int) = v1 := Int.toNat_of_nonneg h1
    rw [e0, e1]
  have hinit : implementation.go v2.toNat v0.toNat (2 * v0.toNat) v1.toNat = true := by
    unfold implementation.go
    by_cases hP : v0.toNat = 0
    · rw [if_pos hP]
    · rw [if_neg hP]
      obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ : ∃ k, v2.toNat = k + 1 := ⟨v2.toNat - 1, by omega⟩
      rw [hk]
      try dsimp only
      have hml := Nat.mul_le_mul_left v0.toNat (show v1.toNat ≤ 10000 by omega)
      rw [if_pos (by omega)]
  have hs := C v2.toNat v0.toNat v1.toNat _ 0 (2 * v0.toNat) rfl (by omega) hinit (Or.inl rfl)
  simp only [implementation, Int.ofNat_eq_natCast]
  generalize implementation.search v2.toNat v0.toNat v1.toNat 0 (2 * v0.toNat) = s at *
  obtain ⟨hA, hB⟩ := hs
  refine ⟨by omega, (key s).mp hA, ?_⟩
  by_cases hz : s = 0
  · left; omega
  · right
    rcases hB with hB | hB
    · omega
    · have e : ((s:Int) - 1) = ((s-1 : Nat):Int) := by omega
      rw [e]
      have hk := key (s-1)
      rw [hB] at hk
      simp at hk
      omega
